label.what: Repairs titles and descriptions corrupted by a bad encoding (mojibake): first locally with a deterministic re-decode, then by fetching the real title from the page when needed.
label.fill_desc: Fill empty descriptions from the page

hint.fill_desc: For bookmarks without a description, fetch the page's meta description. Many web requests — can take a while.
